.5 and 6.35 cents from Freeport, both seen as benchmarks in Asia. Smelters were more confident in receiving higher term charges for next year after they had bought spot shipments this week in London, with TC/RCs reaching $77 and 7.7 cents for clean, standard concentrates, smelter sources said. "Term TC/RCs should be settled at least $75 and 7.5 cents for next year." a trading manager at a Chinese smelter said. 

TC/RC is treatment and refining charges for processing concentrates. Global miners pay TC/RC to smelters to convert concentrate into refined metal and the charges are deducted from the sale price based on LME copper prices . Higher charges are typically seen when concentrate supply rises. Besides, copper scrap supply and demand, smelting cost, SHFE/LME price ratio, by-products price like sulfuric acid, and etc. will make certain influences on TC/RC. Of course, global copper concentrate demand and supply plays a determine role. 

**Global copper concentrate supply sees a surplus in 2013.** International Copper Study Group (ICSG) estimated that the world could see supply surplus of copper concentrate in 2013. That would mark the end of over a decade-long tightness in availability of the mineral for smelting into metal. Principally, on the back of copper mines expansion in Chile and the Oyu Tolgoi copper-gold mine coming on stream, concentrate supply next year, according to ICSG, will see a 6.4 per cent rise. 

**Chinese smelting and refining capacity will be still at a high level in 2013, but growth rate slows down** . Antaike estimated there would be a total of 600ktpy smelting capacity and 1.33 Mt of refining capacity coming on stream in 2012. By the end of 2012, Chinese total smelting and refining capacity would reach 4.67 Mtpy and 8.36 Mtpy, respectively. The peak year of investment in domestic copper smelting sector has passed, but the release of new copper smelting & refining capacity will continue. It is forecasted the domestic copper smelting & refining projects commissioning peak period will continue in 2013. Domestic commissioning refined copper capacity in 2013 may exceed that in 2012. After 2014, the growth would slow down. 

**Chinese domestic refined copper demand is still weak.** Chinese economy faced soft domestic and foreign demand, whose growth slowed down in 2012, putting great stress on copper demand. Chinese refined copper consumption growth rate was estimated to be only 4.8% in 2012, while at 7.8% in 2011. 

**Besides, rising smelting cost will push up TC/RC** . Under current situation of high labor cost and rising resource cost, only TC/RC at the range of USD 60/t - USD 70/t and 6-7 cents per pound can cover smelting cost.

#### **Copper Market Commentary** 

###### **Copper price rebounds, but lack of continuous support** 

LME copper price approached to USD 8000/t in the last two trading days of November. But this rising momentum was curbe

d by worries about United States fiscal cliff and European debt crisis. 

Average prices of LME cash month and 3-month were USD 7,694/t and USD 7,706/t in November 2012, down 4.65% and 4.52% m-o-m, up 1.89% and 1.76% y-o-y, respectively. Although LME copper price again approached to USD 8,000/t in November, the rising momentum was questioned because European debt has no really solution and Euro was easily dragged down by Greek financing and Spain for help. 

Domestic copper price showed a downturn and then stable trend, exceeding 57,000yuan/t in the last one trading day of November. Average prices of SHFE cash month and 3-month were 56,140yuan/t and 56,156 yuan/t, down 3.24% and 3.04% m-o-m, down 0.99% and 0.61% y-o-y, respectively. 

A flash PMI published by HSBC rose to 50.5 in November, going back to above 50 for the first time within 13 months. New export orders index hit a new high of 52.1 for 2012. CPI recorded a new low in 2012, up by 1.7% y-o-y. Chinese data showed that the slowdown in Chinese economy growth hit bottom in Oct. Improving data in November made market participants enhance confidence on Chinese consumption. Positive economic data in America supplied good support for copper market. From a technical point of view, several moving averages began to spread up, good for prices. At the same time, pressures can’t be ignored. On the whole, market is focusing on next FED meeting details. It is estimated copper prices will rebound in shock in future. 

Investors are expecting Chinese new leadership to carry out a new round of stimulus policies, to boost metal prices. But, there are actually no more stimulus points in Chinese macro, as well as Europe and America macro can’t form continuous rising power. It is not suitable for copper price rebounding height to be too optimistic. Some expectations on Chinese economy and demand bottoming up make market confidence not very pessimistic. From a technical point of view, moving average system and chart shows a limited space below and that copper prices start storing energy. But anyway, there are all kinds of uncertainties and relative high pressures above, which make copper prices lack of continuous power. 

It is estimated that LME 3-month copper price will fluctuate between USD 7,750/t and USD 8,200/t, with average price of USD 7,900/t in December. It is estimated that SHFE 3-month copper price will be in the range of 56,000yuan/t and 59,000 yuan/t, with average price of 57,000 yuan/t.

###### **Chinese refined copper production keeps at a high level** 

According to data released by China Nonferrous Metals Industry Association (CNIA), domestic refined copper output reached 494kt in Oct, up 0.8% m-o-m and 10.0% y-o-y. During Jan to Oct, refined copper output amounted 4.67Mt, up 7.4% y-o-y. Data released by the NBS showed that refined copper output was 520kt in Oc

t, with m-o-m rise of 1.8% and y-o-y rise of 8.6%; refined copper output amounted to 4.94Mt during Jan to Oct, up by 7.4% y-o-y. Besides, according to Antaike’s statistics, copper cathode output of domestic 12 enterprises reached 360.1kt in Oct, down by 3.44% m-o-m; copper cathode output of domestic 12 enterprises amounted to 3.43Mt during Jan to Oct, up by 6.58% y-o-y. Among them, copper cathode output in Jiangxi Copper, Tongling Nonferrous, Jinchuang Group and Yunnan Copper accounted for 28.46%, 20.93%, 15.08% and 8.72%, respectively. According to above data, refined copper output in Oct still kept at a high level. The main reason for the high level of Chinese refined copper output is Chinese expanding smelting/refining copper capacity in 2012. Besides, historical high level of total net import (physical quantity) for copper concentrates and copper scrap supplied large amount of raw materials for refined copper production, which were 1.13Mt, 1.16Mt and 1.11Mt from Aug to Oct, respectively. www.antaike.com 5 Copper Monthly No. 192 ###### **Chinese refined copper imports decline to a rational level** According to data released by China’s Customs, China impoted refined copper 231kt refined copper in Oct, down 21.7% m-o-m and 21.9% y-o-y. During Jan to Oct, imported refined copper amounted to 2.91Mt, up 39.7% y-o-y. The m-o-m decline was in line with expectations, because of domestic refined copper still in surplus, low SHFE/LME copper price ratio, tightening mortage policy for financial copper activity and stockpiling action before Chinese National Day Holidays. Besides, higher CIF premium in other countries still drew part of imported refined copper. It is estimated that refined copper import will keep at a rational level. Refined copper export was 13kt in Oct, up by 58.8% m-o-m, at 322t in Oct. 2011, which is a great increase. Exported refined copepr amounted to 228kt in Jan to Oct, up 47.9% y-o-y. Current high refined copper production in Chinese smelters, as well as lower domestic consumption and lower price ratio between SHFE and LME stimulated refined copper export. China imported 394kt copper scraps in Oct, down 14.1% y-o-y. Under this situation, most traders prefer to purchase refined copper instead of copper scraps. Chinese National Day still have infulence on copper scrap import. It is estimated that copper scraps import will be curbed in next two months, in cosideration of factors metioned above. Copper concentrate import was 716kt in Oct, up 1.6% m-o-m and 41.2% y-oy. With the tight supply of copper scrap, as well as the growth of domestic smelting/refining capacity and refined copper production, Chinese demand for copper concentrate will increase and copper concentrate import will climb up to a historical top. It is estimated that copper scrap supply won’t get better, but copper concentrate import will keep at a high level. Import and Export of Refined Cu 2009-2012 , tonne

###### **Copper consumption** According to statistics from the NBS, main copper end-using products had m-o-m decline in Oct, influenced by Chinese National Day Holidays. But, the improving signals of refined copper consumption can’t be ignored. Main copper end-using products including air conditioners, power cable and autos had y-o-y rise, seen from data in Jan to Oct. According to the Ministry of Railways, PRC, railway infrastructure investment was 69.77 bln yuan in Oct, up 240.8% y-o-y and 8.5% m-o-m. Railway infrastructure investment in 2013 expects to exceed 516 bln yuan and four financing channels have been determined, like enlarging collection range of railway construction fund, continuously issuing railway construction bonds of 150 bln yan, more financial and bank credit support for railway construction. But it needs a long time for railway infrastructure www.antaike.com 7 Copper Monthly No. 192 investment to be shown in refined copper consumption and won’t directly promote actual consumption in a short time. Data from China Electricity Council still showed that during Jan to Oct, the completed power investment was 545.3 billion yuan, up 2.22% y-o-y. Among them, investment in power generation and grid was 267.6 billion yuan and 277.7 billion yuan, down 3.06% or up 7.89% compared with the same period of 2011, respectively. Of power generation investment, investment in thermal power was 71.7 billion yuan, down 12.40% y-o-y, whose proportion in total power generation power decreased to 26.78%, down 2.9 percentage points lower than the same period of 2011; investment in hydropower was 91.2 billion yuan, up 28.85% y-o-y; investment in nuclear power was 59.7 billion yuan, down 0.35% y-o-y; investment in wind power was 41.5 billion yuan, down by 24.61% y-o-y. investment proportion in hydropower, nuclear and wind power had a clear rise compared to the same period of 201, at 71.93% y-o-y. Investment in domestic real estate development was 5.7629 trillion yuan in Jan-Oct, nominal up by 15.4% y-o-y, flat with that in Jan to Sept. Among them, investment in residential houses was 3.9704 trillion yuan, up by 10.8% y-o-y, 0.3 percentage points higher than that in Jan to Sept, accounting for 68.9% of the total investment in real estate. During Jan to Sept, floor space under construction was 5381.49 mln sq.m, up by 13.3% y-o-y, 0.7 p

ercentage points lower than that in Jan to Sept. Of them, floor space under construction of residential houses was 4032.03 mln sq.m, at a rise of 10.9% y-o-y. Starting floor space of houses was 1467.92 mln sq.m, down by 8.5% y-o-y, 0.1 percentage points lower than that in Jan to Sept, of which starting floor space of residential houses was 1083.96 mln sq.m, down by 12.7% y-o-y. Completion floor space of houses was 583.17 mln sq.m, up by 17.3% y-o-y, 0.9 percentage points higher than that in Jan to Sept, of which completion floor space of residential houses was 467.92 mln sq.m, up by 17.1% y-o-y. On the whole, electric power investment growth rate was not high and Chinese property industry was still influenced by home-purchase restrictions, which curbed domestic refined copper demand. Refined copper consumption will have a slight rise, but still a little lower than expected. Net import of refined copper will be at a relative rational level, at 230kt in November. On the whole, domestic refined copper supply will still show a slight surplus in November, with surplus quantity narrowed slightly, at 30kt in November. Currently Chinese economy goes stable and inflationary pressure also is not very big, which make market confidence enhanced. But copper prices are lack of a continuous rising power without further looser policies in China. It is estimated that SHFE 3-month copper price will be in the range of 56,000yuan/t and 59,000 yuan/t, with average price of 57,000 yuan/t. ### **Industrial News** 

**Guangxi Nonferrous’s** Guangxi Nonferrous Metals Group Co., Ltd. (Guangxi Nonferrous) held **300ktpy secondary** a completion ceremony for 300ktpy secondary copper project in Wuzhou **copper project** Recycling Industrial Park in China's Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region **commenced** On Nov. 2, 2012. The project was constructed by 3 stages. Stage 1, with 200ktpy tilting furnace was finished and put into running in 2011; stage 2, with 100ktpy Kaldo furnace, produced the first batch of copper cathode in May 2012; stage 3 was electrolytic system construction. The whole project, with total investment of 2.452 billion yuan and total capacity of 300ktpy, can offer 700 jobs for local people. 

According to the Future Planning, Guangxi Nonferrous wants to invest in 3 billion yuan in 300ktpy secondary aluminium, 250ktpy metal deep processing and precious metals recycling and comprehensive utilization in Wuzhou Recycling Industrial Park. 

**Stage 2 of Tibet Jiama** Tibet Huatailong Mining Development Co., Ltd (Huatailong) hold the **Cu project kicks off** production ceremony for stage 2 of Jiama copper polymetallic deposit on Sept 18, 2012. Huatailong is wholly owned by China Gold through a number of subsidiary companies. Huatailong completed four phases of exploration work between 2008 and 2011. Stage 2 will be invested 5 billion yuan and expects to be finished by the end of “12th Five Year Period”. Three types of copper-polymetallic mineralisation are observed within the project, including skarn, hornfels and porphyry. Total measured copper metal was 364kt, according to Pre-Feasibility Study Technical Report for the project.

In March of 2012, Nyкmo County finished mineral resources evaluation and report for the record. As of Dec. 31 of 2011, copper resource in this place is 1.3735Mt, 7.066kt molybdenum resource and 4.35t gold resource, with the late two of associated metals.
